event.proposal: Family: position representation. Retained incumbent is 3283 parameters at 99.990000%, a +0.990000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0027, learned positional rank 5 (3283, 99.99%); the prior rank-6 standard-schedule optimization failure was superseded by the accepted rank-6 changed-condition result, and the most recent distinct failed positional substitution is attempt-0017's fixed rank-8 basis; 7 prior position-representation macro-attempts plus the rank-7 schedule reattempt. Hypothesis: rank 4 may preserve the small set of fixed-format positional roles while retaining the successful learned projection and 45000-step schedule, removing another 49 actual parameters (3283 to 3234). This is a representational positional factorization, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning. It is more informative than the nearest untested rank-3 alternative because it is the immediate one-coordinate compression boundary from the exceptionally high-margin rank-5 incumbent.
